claims.quote: STICKY — the red ball sticks to surfaces instead of bouncing
Luca carefully tosses the ball once between his hands
It drops directly onto his CHEEK and sticks there with a soft PLUP
It sticks to Luca’s cheek only, never covering his nose or mouth
The ball stretches toward him like soft chewing gum while its center remains stuck to the wall
This time the BALL stays stuck and the WOODEN WALL itself flexes slightly toward Luca like soft rubber

beats.action:
— HARD HOOK
FIRST FRAME:
Luca has JUST thrown the red ball at the wooden wall.
Instead of bouncing back, the ball is already STUCK flat to the wall.
Luca is frozen with both hands half-raised, eyes wide.
The impossible sticky ball must dominate the opening.

SFX: THWIP — STICK.

— REACTION
Luca walks straight to the ball and pulls it with one hand.
It will not move.
He uses both hands.

— FIRST ATTEMPT
Luca pulls harder.
The ball stretches toward him like soft chewing gum while its center remains stuck to the wall.
He lets go.

SNAP!
The ball instantly returns to the wall.

— ESCALATION
Luca grabs the ball again with both hands and leans backward.
This time the BALL stays stuck and the WOODEN WALL itself flexes slightly toward Luca like soft rubber.
Luca’s eyes widen.
He immediately releases it.

BOING!
The wall returns safely to normal.

— SECOND ATTEMPT
The ball finally drops from the wall by itself.
Luca catches it.
He squeezes it gently.
It behaves like a normal ball.
He smiles.

— FAKE RESOLUTION
Luca carefully tosses the ball once between his hands.
Normal.
He relaxes.

— FINAL TWIST
Luca gives the ball one tiny playful toss upward.
It drops directly onto his CHEEK and sticks there with a soft PLUP.
Luca goes cross-eyed trying to look at it.

PLUP! — HARD CUT.

SAFETY
The ball is soft.
It sticks to Luca’s cheek only, never covering his nose or mouth.

DIALOGUE
None.
